units.source_text: 我心想，这个胆大包天的、残酷的、目光敏锐的士官正在走向罪恶啊。

en.t: I thought that this audacious, cruel, sharp-eyed officer was now heading toward evil.

units.source_text: 他脚蹬半长统靴奔跑在道路上，前方有宛如战争中的死亡一样、又如朝霞一般的无秩序。

en.t: He ran along the road in half-length boots, and ahead of him lay a disorder like death in war, and like the morning glow.

units.source_text: 他胸前飘忽着白围巾，背上背着偷来的物资，几乎把背都压弯了。

en.t: A white scarf fluttered at his chest, and on his back he carried stolen supplies, nearly bending under their weight.

units.source_text: 夜间的风刮在他的脸颊上，他出发了。

en.t: The night wind struck his cheeks, and he set out.

units.source_text: 他将以惊人的速度走向毁灭吧。

en.t: He would surely move toward destruction at an astonishing speed.

units.source_text: 然而，在更远的地方，更轻快的地方，响起了无秩序的光芒四射的钟楼的钟……

en.t: Yet in a farther place, a lighter place, there rang the bell of a disorderly bell tower scattering radiant light in every direction...
